# Dorado Project

> Dorado Project is a genre-fluid music project. Tracks are inspired by ideas, journeys, people and moments rather than one fixed genre.

Official website: https://doradoproject.com/

## Releases and stories

- [Slow Down the Sun](https://doradoproject.com/releases/slow-down-the-sun.html): in production. English-language orchestral soul with a husky baritone, acoustic guitar, soft drums and warm strings. A song about wanting time to stand still; Spotify link to follow when available.

- **Ruby Runs the Night**: in production. English-language dark rock 'n' roll with heavy guitars, rockabilly swing and a deep baritone. Cover art and a release card are on the official website; audio and a Spotify link will follow.
- [Dorado Danst Door De Melkweg](https://open.spotify.com/track/0a9m01T0YeX8IQqgZaSRhB): Dutch electro-hiphop and synthpop single with elastic synth bass, vocoder, 8-bit bleeps, laser zaps and a playful zero-gravity chorus.
- [Brood met pasta én hagelslag](https://open.spotify.com/track/2k0VtQtXkw3K3J0lVV1qng): Dutch brass-pop and ska-pop single with funky bass, Hammond organ, handclaps, bright brass and a playful double-chocolate breakfast theme.
- [Dorado Project](https://doradoproject.com/): official homepage and release overview.
- [The Space Between the Signals](https://open.spotify.com/track/7nXXsy77nMBw13mBr0RUuS): English-language progressive art-rock single with analog synthesizers, spacious guitar, fretless bass, deep drums and distant saxophone.
- **Op karakter**: upcoming Dutch funk-rock single submitted by Jilke Kooijker of Terra 1888, inspired by a rafting injury, a punishing Chamonix descent and the friends who helped him finish.
- [Brood met pindakaas](https://open.spotify.com/track/5t0DhDVzLco7fVkwnxSg1s): Dutch funk-pop, disco and ska single with slap bass, brass, electric guitar and saxophone.
- [Neon Sax Drive](https://open.spotify.com/track/24uxBM9Q1QBSMO1K5md8fg): instrumental synthwave and jazz-rock single featuring synthesizers, electric guitar, saxophones and a virtuoso drum solo.
- [De top is nooit het eindpunt](https://open.spotify.com/track/5ocVnbCZkumVALinHFYfCD): Dutch pop-rock mountain anthem by Dorado Project.
- [CHAMONIX 2712](https://open.spotify.com/track/76GIGuqKAEbLPikUncWRsE): pop-rock track inspired by a mountain trip to Chamonix and the Mont Blanc landscape. [Story and photo journal](https://doradoproject.com/chamonix.html).
- [Midnight Overdrive](https://open.spotify.com/track/387TkwMvZBSsrUE1vJpvdb): electronic big beat and breakbeat single built for empty roads and flashing lights.

## Back to Who We Are
- Artist: Dorado Project
- Status: Coming soon on Spotify
- Genre: Arena rock / Alternative rock
- Language: English
- Summary: An epic stadium anthem about friendship, losing your way and finding the road back to who you truly are.
